ordered_diagnoses: Acute posterior multifocal placoid pigment epitheliopathy

s1.syndrome_frame: Acute monocular visual disturbance with optic disc swelling and retinal lesions in a young adult with a history of neurofibroma
salient_findings: Grey dot in central vision of left eye
Swollen optic disc in right eye
Parafoveal grey-white deep retinal lesion in left eye
Cotton-wool spot in posterior pole of left eye
Central scotoma in left eye
key_facts: 18-year-old Chinese woman
Known plexiform neurofibroma of the arm
No medical history, trauma, family history, smoking, coffee, tea, illicit drugs, or oral contraceptive use
Blood pressure 110/70 mmHg
Visual acuity 20/20 in right eye and 20/25 in left eye
No relative afferent pupillary defect
Mild subcapsular cataracts bilaterally
Bilateral vestibular schwannomas on brain MRI
Parasellar mass consistent with meningioma on brain MRI
Cervical extramedullary lesion on brain MRI
Normal carotid Doppler ultrasound and transthoracic echocardiography
Normal laboratory studies, including complete blood count and inflammatory markers

per_call: Acute posterior multifocal placoid pigment epitheliopathy

shortlist: Acute posterior multifocal placoid pigment epitheliopathy

shortlist.label: Neurofibromatosis type 1
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has known plexiform neurofibroma and bilateral vestibular schwannomas

shortlist.label: Paracentral acute middle maculopathy
shortlist.why_kept: Swept-source optical coherence tomography showed hyperreflective bands in the inner nuclear layer

shortlist.label: Optic neuritis
shortlist.why_kept: Swollen optic disc in the right eye and central scotoma in the left eye

shortlist.label: Papilledema
shortlist.why_kept: Swollen optic disc in the right eye, but normal intracranial pressure suggested by normal carotid Doppler and transthoracic echocardiography

shortlist.label: Acute posterior multifocal placoid pigment epitheliopathy
shortlist.why_kept: Presence of parafoveal grey-white deep retinal lesion and cotton-wool spot in the posterior pole

raw.rationale: The patient has a known plexiform neurofibroma of the arm and multiple bilateral vestibular schwannomas, a parasellar mass consistent with a meningioma, and a cervical extramedullary lesion, which are characteristic findings of Neurofibromatosis type 1

rejected.label: Paracentral acute middle maculopathy
rejected.why: While the patient has findings consistent with paracentral acute middle maculopathy, this condition does not explain the other systemic findings such as plexiform neurofibroma and bilateral vestibular schwannomas

rejected.label: Optic neuritis
rejected.why: The patient does not have typical symptoms of optic neuritis such as pain on eye movement or decreased visual acuity in the affected eye

rejected.label: Papilledema
rejected.why: The patient does not have elevated intracranial pressure or other signs of papilledema

rejected.label: Acute posterior multifocal placoid pigment epitheliopathy
rejected.why: The patient's findings are not consistent with this condition, which typically presents with multiple placoid lesions at the level of the retinal pigment epithelium
